reason: planning stopped before any code was written: the plan still needed revising in the last round (round 3 of 3). Verdict: revise. The plan is sound overall and its main claims about the code hold up. I confirmed that `Tools` uses deny_unknown_fields (crates/athena-data/src/config.rs:267), that `count_tests` only understands libtest's `test result:` lines (crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs:29), that `failing_test_name` exists in gh.rs, and that `install_gitleaks` and the ATHENA_NESTED refusal exist in xtask. Each change sits where the fault starts. The three files outside the reading's list (checks.rs, gh.rs, config.rs) are justified, and the plan records why in the decision. Using one `test` check, so CI routing stays unchanged, is a good choice. The major problem is that the wrapper looks for the pinned nextest under athena_home(). Checks get a cleared environment that passes only HOME, PATH and a fixed list, and that list has no ATHENA_HOME or XDG_DATA_HOME. On a machine that sets either one, every check quietly falls back to `cargo test`: no speedup, and a wrong after-median. The fix is small: set ATHENA_HOME from `{athena_home}` in the capability env, and have the wrapper report which runner it used. Two minor points: a CI pin that may be unverified could break all of CI, and nothing in this job shows the real check counting tests through nextest. Findings: minor: crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs is not among the reading's deliverables (files, crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs); minor: crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs is not among the reading's deliverables (files, crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs); minor: crates/athena-data/src/config.rs is not among the reading's deliverables (files, crates/athena-data/src/config.rs); major: The wrapper may never find the pinned nextest inside Athena's own checks, and the plan has nothing that would notice. The check would then quietly fall back to plain `cargo test` and run no faster. (Decision 2 / Step 4 (wrapper path resolution); athena.toml [capabilities.change.env] and [capabilities.study.env]); minor: Criterion 3 asks for a checksum pin, but the plan allows an unverified pin to land. A wrong pin makes CI setup fail for every pull request, not just this one. (Decision 6 / Risks (wrong pin)); minor: The demonstration for criterion 5 does not show that the real test check runs nextest. It only shows that the parsers and the exit logic work on sample output. (Demonstrations, criterion 5)
